test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the main advantage of renewable energy over fossil fuels?

options.text: It is cheaper than traditional fossil fuels.
It produces the greenhouse gases that are responsible for climate change.
It is not limited by the same supply constraints as fossil fuels.
The renewable energy sources will eventually run out

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind power, are not limited by the same supply constraints as fossil fuels.
 
• Unlike fossil fuels, which are finite resources that will eventually run out, renewable energy sources will never be depleted.
 
• Additionally, renewable energy does not produce greenhouse gases that contribute to climate change, making it more environmentally friendly.
 
• Thus, the main advantage of renewable energy over fossil fuels is its unlimited availability.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect. The passage mentions that the cost of renewable energy is currently higher than fossil fuels.
 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect. Renewable energy does not produce greenhouse gases; rather, it helps reduce them.
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect. Renewable energy sources will never run out, unlike fossil fuels.
